Seal of Righteousness
Level 60
200 Mana
Instant

Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 24 to 83 Holy damage.  Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 187 to 203 Holy damage to an enemy.
